title: Python: a class-body read of a name the class body binds is never resolved through an enclosing function's binding, Rule 6d's single-binding shortcut included (DEC-303 (a73))
description: HOLD, wrong edge on dev. Filed record-only under DEC-303 (a73) (N3 of (a72) item 3; relayed by the leader 2026-11-26). Found by GCLI-112's round 3 review of opum-ai/glyph-cli#220 (landed 3a422ec1). RULE (a73) item 2: a class-body read of a name the class body binds ANYWHERE is never resolved through an enclosing function's binding. That includes Rule 6d's single-binding shortcut (knownClassOf, calls.ts), which takes the same guard #220 gave the multi-binding path (enumerableBindings, via withoutTypeParameterScopes). It should only REMOVE edges. Any CREATED in-repo edge on the five pins comes to opum-doc before the PR; removed edges are reported with the PR. Schedule per (a73) item 3: right after GCLI-112, before the (a25) attribute-write rule (GCLI-140) and ahead of the rest of GCLI-140 to 143; two review rounds under DEC-161's cap; the (a36) item 8 pre-registration (GCLI-143) waits for it. MEASURED on origin/dev (before #220; identical on #220's head): source = class C with def run; def outer(): x = C() [one binding, or x = C(); x = C() for two]; class Outer: <READ> then from m import X as x (m.X has run). Forms: eager y = x.run(); lazy alias type A = x.run(); lazy generic alias type A[T] = x.run(). One binding: all three give inRepo 1 with an edge to C.run (WRONG). Two bindings: all three REFUSED (inRepo 0, receiver 1, no edge), because Rule 6d returns null and R4 reaches the enumerableBindings class-body guard. RUNTIME EVIDENCE (CPython, python3 -I): def outer(): x = C(); class Outer: try: y = x.run() except Exception as e: y = type(e).__name__ + ': ' + str(e); x = 1; return Outer.y gives 'NameError: name x is not defined': a class body reads a name it binds from the class, then globals, then builtins, never from the enclosing function; the two lazy aliases evaluate after the body has bound x to the import. glyph-cli picks the build. Not started; the leader briefs it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The three forms (eager read, type A, type A[T]) with ONE binding of x in the enclosing function assert toEqual(REFUSED) and no C.run edge: red on origin/dev, green after, each measured by running both
The two-binding twins stay REFUSED (they are refused today); a single-binding twin with no class-body binding of x keeps resolving through the enclosing function
A mutant that drops the guard turns the one-binding fixtures red
The five-pin delta: any CREATED in-repo edge comes to opum-doc before the PR; removed edges are listed with the PR; two review rounds at most (DEC-161)
